en.title: Accessibility considerations for project websites
en.lead: What WCAG 2.2 AA means in practice for EU project websites, and where teams most often fall short.

sections.heading: Accessibility is part of the brief
paragraphs: Treat accessibility as part of the original specification, not as a remediation effort before review. WCAG 2.2 Level AA is a useful accessibility target when planning a project website. The precise compliance requirements depend on the organisation operating the site and any applicable legal or contractual obligations.
